title: Grateful Dead Live at Seattle Center Coliseum on 1979-07-01
lineage: Master played back on Nak Dragon> Grace Lunatec V3 (24/96)> Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe> Adobe Audition 2.0> (dither/downsample)> FLAC encoding
source: 2 Sony ECM-270s on pole 35' from stage> Sony TC-158SD (2 Maxell UD XL-IIs)

ai_review.summary: Good-quality recording captures a great Half-Step > Franklin's Tower, Sugaree and the post‑Dark Star jam.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises this set for its standout Half‑Step → Franklin's Tower sequence, a solid Sugaree performance, and an engaging post‑Dark Star section. Recording quality is described as good, making the show well worth listening to despite the unknown source type.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single positive review (4 stars) mentioning solid performance and decent recording; insufficient data for higher confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes good recording quality with no specific issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows through strong jams, highlighted by the Half‑Step → Franklin's Tower sequence and Sugaree, with a satisfying post‑Dark Star segment.
